sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The maamar explains that the speech of the Ten Commandments was such that each individual heard it as if spoken directly to them, because G-d associated His name with each Jew.

translations.translation: And it is explained in the maamar, the reason for this, that the speech of the Ten Commandments was in a manner of "the speech of the Speaker speaking,"
in singular language to each and every one individually
[even though all the commandments of the Torah are for each and every Jew, and in the entire Torah it is stated "I am the L-rd your G-d"],
according to what is brought in the Yalkut there,
that at the time of the Giving of the Torah, the Holy One, blessed be He, associated His name with each and every Jew.
For this is what is written,
"The chariots of G-d are myriads, etc., the L-rd is among them at Sinai, in holiness,"
that just as "the L-rd is among them"
(among the angels),
that in the name of each angel is associated
(at its end)
the name of the Holy One, blessed be He,
"El"
(Michael, Gabriel, Raphael),
so too at the Giving of the Torah,
"Sinai, in holiness,"
the Holy One, blessed be He, associated His name with each and every Jew,
"I am the L-rd your G-d."
And the maamar continues,
that through the fact that the name of the Holy One, blessed be He, is associated in the angels,
they are nullified relative to His name, may He be blessed, that is associated in them.
And likewise is it with Israel,
that through the fact that the Holy One, blessed be He, associated His name in Israel,
they are in a state of nullification,
as is explained at length in the maamar.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The name of G-d associated with Israel is the name Havayah, which is higher than the name associated with angels, and its revelation within the body comes from the aspect of "Anochi" which is above even Havayah.

translations.translation: Now, the name of the Holy One, blessed be He, that He associated in Israel is higher than the name that is associated in the angels.
For regarding the angels it is written "the L-rd is among them,"
and as is explained in Tanya
that the angels are called by the name Elokim,
for Elokim and "the L-rd" (Ad-nai) are
(generally)
one concept,
but regarding Israel it is written,
"For the portion of Havayah is His people,"
a portion from the name Havayah.
And even though the concept of "the portion of Havayah is His people" existed also before the Giving of the Torah,
it did not shine in revelation
(so much),
for the concept of "the portion of Havayah is His people" is from the aspect of the soul,
and in the descent of the soul below,
the body conceals and hides the soul and the name Havayah that is in it,
and at the Giving of the Torah,
through the speech "I am the L-rd your G-d,"
this was drawn into revelation.
And as is explained in Likkutei Torah,
that the explanation of
("Anochi")
"Havayah your G-d" is,
that Havayah will illuminate and be revealed in you so much that it will be called by your name,
"your G-d."
And the power for "Havayah your G-d"
[that even after the soul is clothed in the body, Havayah will be in him in revelation, to the extent that it will be called by his name]
is from the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof, which is above even Havayah.
For the name Havayah
(in its own right),
its revelation is specifically above,
and in order for it to be in revelation below in a physical body, it is through the drawing down of the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof, which is above Havayah,
for whatever is higher descends and is revealed lower more.
And this is "I am (Anochi) Havayah your G-d,"
that the power for this, that Havayah will be your G-d,
is from the aspect of Anochi, which is above even Havayah.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Since the name associated with Israel is Havayah, whose source is in Anochi above even Havayah, the nullification of Israel is greater than that of the angels.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that since the name of the Holy One, blessed be He, that He associated in Israel is the name Havayah, which is above the name "the L-rd" (Ad-nai) that is associated in the angels
[and particularly, the root of the association of His name in Israel is from the aspect of Anochi, which is above even Havayah],
therefore,
also the nullification of Israel that is brought about through His name, may He be blessed, that is associated in them, is a greater nullification than the nullification of the angels.
